name: Laura Luciana Santos
office: Mt. San Antonio Community College District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 3

items.text: Laura Luciana Santos is the Mt. San Antonio College Board of Trustees vice president for Area 3, first elected in 2013 and re-elected in 2022. She has also served on the Bassett Unified School District Board and works as a public relations representative. She practiced law for 10 years. The State Bar of California lists her as disbarred and prohibited from practicing law in California.
